GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (31 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 686)
APO 500
31 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of German Nationals in Japan.
1. Reference is made to the following:
a. C. L. O. No.121 (5.1), dated 10 January 1946, subject: "Repatriation of German Nationals in Japan."
b. Memorandum this headquarters file AG 370.05 (19 Jan 46)GC, dated 19 January 1946, subject as above.
2. It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government conduct a survey and furnish to this headquarters by 15 February 1946 the following:
a. Nominal rolls of German Nationals in Japan desiring repatriation with their places of former residence in Germany by town or city REGIERUNGSBESERK and province.
b. A separate list of these Germans to include the following information:
(1) Name
(2) Local address
(3) Age
(4) Sex
c. The information to be furnished in paragraph b above will be grouped by families.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
